articles.title: ETHGas wants to bring Wall Street to public Ethereum with institutional controls
articles.snippet: The proposed service would offer sanctions screening and qualified validators, but current compensation for failed commitments is set at zero.

articles.title: Claude-Built Linux Exploit Targets Bug That Ubuntu Still Hasn't Patched
articles.snippet: Anthropic says Claude wrote an attack that can take over a Linux server with no password. Red Hat patched on Sunday, but Ubuntu still has no fix.

articles.title: Proton Users Revolt After CEO Calls Security Caution 'Loser Thinking' Amid AI Push
articles.snippet: Proton customers say they are canceling subscriptions after reports of pressure to adopt AI coding, as the privacy company scraps employee re-interviews but defends its broader shift toward automated development.

articles.title: How to Run an AI Model Locally—And Why You Might Want To
articles.snippet: Free tools like Ollama and LM Studio can run open-weight AI models on your laptop, offline, and without a subscription. Here's how to get started.
